SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But what can I do that's more concrete... I can't think of anything.
[FI] I can't stand the troubled look on her face.
[FI] I could say something, but I have nothing good in mind...
[FI] Well then, what should I do...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm...

[FI] That's why she can't accept the idea of throwing one away for the rest of her life.
[FI] I understand Saori's feelings when she says she's doing it for her parents.
[FI] But I don't believe that it is in Saori's interests to bend herself to what her parents want!
[FI] At times like this, what should I say to her?
[FI] No good, nothing comes to my mind...

TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi? Is something the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You've been a bit pale for a while...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Perhaps...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] The summer's heat got to you, and your thought-patterns are on the verge of blowing up?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] N-Nah... Nothing like that...
[FI] T-This is pitiful...
[FI] I wanted to cheer her up, but instead only made her worry; that's so lame...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Having to suddenly hear all about this must be pretty confusing!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] How about leaving it at that for today and talk again tomorrow?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't particularly mind, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you really fine with it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm fine, don't worry!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Simply being able to talk with you like this took a weight off my shoulders, and turned out fun.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am deeply thankful to you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see. That's good to hear.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well then, if anything happens again, contact me!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Roger!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't take it all on yourself, okay?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Acknowledged!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you give up now, it means that you're giving up the things that you have cherished.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Things that I cherish...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. Things that you cherished up to now.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Of course. Just like you said, these are my treasures.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Those treasures... figures, games, anime and manga...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that something you can easily give up? They are treasures because they can't be replaced, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you surrender your otaku hobbies now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It will be as you said, I will never be able to give you that souvenir.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You would have to spend the rest of your life without touching manga, figures, anime or games, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Will you be able to endure such a dull and boring life?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Wait, I remember!!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] K-Kyousuke-shi?
